children.html: Marinated hare in wine sauce - Zajic na černo

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: Marinade:

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 cup sliced carrots
  • • 1 cup sliced onions
  • • 1 cup sliced shallots
  • • 3 cloves garlic, crushed
  • • 10 black peppercorns
  • • 3 bay leaves
  • • thyme
  • • 1/4 cup cognac
  • • 3 cups red wine
  • • 1-1/2 cups vegetable oil

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: Hare and sauce:

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • Front part of 1 hare, 4-5 lbs.
  • • 4 tablespoons butter
  • • 3 oz. bacon, diced
  • • 1 medium onion, chopped
  • • 3 tablespoons vinegar
  • • 1-1/2 cups beef stock
  • • 1 cup red wine
  • • grated rind of 1 lemon
  • • 5 grains each of black peppercorns and whole allspice
  • • 2 bay leaves, thyme
  • • 4 tablespoons flour
  • • 2 tablespoons brown sugar
  • • 1/4 cup cranberry sauce
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: To marinate:

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Place hare in a large crock. Add all dry ingredients, top with cognac, add wine.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Add oil to seal air out. The hare must be submerged in the marinade. Soak hare overnight, or even better 2-3 days.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Remove and wipe dry with a cloth.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Heat butter in a 4 quart top-of-range casserole. Add bacon and onion and cook until soft. Add all spices and lemon rind. Sprinkle hare with salt and vinegar, put into casserole, and brown lightly on all sides.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Reduce heat. Add some of the beef stock.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Cover tightly and simmer 1-1-1/2 hours, or until meat is tender when pierced with a fork. Add beef stock occasionally.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Transfer hare to a heated platter.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Skim off fat from the cooking liquid, stir in the flour and continue cooking to a rich brown. Add the remaining beef stock and the wine.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Cook until sauce thickens. Strain, blend in sugar and cranberry sauce. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Bring to boil, stirring constantly.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Slice hare, pour hot sauce over top.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serve with noodles, gnocchi, dumplings.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 2 hours, plus marinating

children.html: Venison cutlets, or medallions - Srnči žebírka

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 12 young venison cutlets, or medallions, 3 oz. ea.
  • • 12 juniper berries, crushed
  • • 4 tablespoons cognac
  • • salt and pepper
  • • 1·1/2 cups sour cream
  • • 1/2 cup chicken broth
  • • 3/4 cup olive oil
  • • 4 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 small onion, finely chopped
  • • 1 lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced lengthwise
  • • snipped parsley

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Trim excess fat from the cutlets, pound them lightly, rub with juniper berries, sprinkle with salt and pepper, drizzle with cognac and olive oil. Cover, marinate at least 1 hour.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Meanwhile melt butter in a large skillet, sauté onion and mushrooms. Season with salt and pepper. Reserve.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Drain and wipe the cutlets, reserve marinade. Heat remaining oil in a heavy frying pan, fry venison over high heat, about 3 minutes each side. Remove cutlets, keep them warm. Deglaze pan with marinade. Add chicken broth and sour cream, simmer 5 minutes. Taste for salt and pepper.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Coat the cutlets, or medallions, with the sauce. Garnish with mushrooms, snipped parsley, poached halves of apples, serve with noodles, rice.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 20 minutes, plus marinating

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: Roast pheasant - Bažant pečený

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 pheasant
  • • 2 slices bacon cut in short strips
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 medium onion, finely chopped
  • • 3·4 tablespoons flour
  • • 1·1/2 cups chicken broth
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse and wipe the pheasant inside and out. Lard the breast and thighs with bacon strips. Brown the pheasant evenly all around in a frying pan in half of the butter and onion. Preheat oven to 350F. Transfer pheasant, breast down, into an ovenproof deep dish together with the butter and onion from the frying pan. Add salt and pepper. Roast 30·40 minutes, until the top gets reddish. Baste often with the remaining butter and chicken broth. Turn the bird breast side up, continue roasting in the same manner, 40-45 minutes.

children.html: On the stove top bring the pan juices to boil. Add flour and cook 5 minutes stirring constantly. Add the remaining chicken broth and cook a little more. children.html: Pheasant in cream sauce - Bažant na smetanë

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 pheasant
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • 2 slices bacon cut in short strips
  • • 1 medium onion, finely chopped
  • • 1 cup chicken broth
  • • 1-1/2 cups heavy cream
  • • 2 tablespoons grated horseradish
  • • 1 tablespoon cognac
  • • juice of 1 lemon
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse and wipe the pheasant inside and out. Lard the breast and thighs with bacon strips. Roast pheasant as indicated in "Roast pheasant". In a saucepan blend pan juices, cream and horseradish. Cook for 5 minutes over medium heat. Add cognac and lemon juice. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Strain.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Pour some gravy over the pheasant cut in 4 portions. Serve remaining gravy separately. Serve with rice, vegetables.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 4 – Preparation time: 1 hour 30 minutes

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: Partridge/Quail - Koroptev/Křepelka

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 6 quails
  • • 3 slices bacon
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 cup chicken broth, or water
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Rinse quails, pat dry. Sprinkle with salt and pepper inside and outside. Place 1/2 slice bacon inside each. Heat butter in a flameproof casserole, add quails. Roast 40-50 minutes at 350F. Baste often with pan drippings, chicken broth or water. Serve dish straight from the oven with quails cut in halves.

children.html: Baked carp - Kapr pečený

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html:
Arrange carp steaks in a single layer in a well oiled baking pan.
Season with caraway seeds, salt and pepper. Bake at 350F 25-30
minutes, or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork.
In a saucepan heat butter until lightly browned. Pour over fish.
Garnish with lemon wedges.
Serve with potatoes, vegetables, salad.

children.html: Fried carp - Kapr smažený

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html:
Soak fish 30 minutes in lightly salted milk. Dredge each piece in flour,
dip in beaten eggs, coat with bread crumbs. Fry in hot oil until golden,
about 4 minutes each side. Drain on paper towel.
Serve on lettuce lined platter, garnish with lemon wedges and parsley
sprigs.
Serve with potato salad, green salad, vegetables.

children.html: Carp with paprika sauce - Kapr na paprice

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 6 carp steaks, 3-4 lbs.
  • • 1-1/2 cups water or fish broth
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 medium onion, finely chopped
  • • parsley, finely chopped
  • • 2 tablespoons paprika
  • • salt
  • • 3 tablespoons butter and 4 tablespoons flour for the roux

Optional: 1/2 cup heavy cream

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Melt butter in a large saucepot, add onion and cook until translucent. Add parsley and paprika, simmer 3 minutes. Add the fish and some of the fish broth or water.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Cover and simmer 15-20 minutes.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Using a slotted spatula, lift the carp portions onto a heated platter. For sauce, melt butter in a skillet and stir in flour. Cook and stir until golden.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Add cooking liquid from the carp and some of the fish broth if needed. Cook until sauce thickens. Optional: for a creamier sauce blend in heavy cream. Season to taste with salt and pepper. Strain over fish. Serve with mashed potatoes, rice, tomato salad.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 45 minutes

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: ⇔ Perch, Pike, or Trout with paprika sauce – Candát, Štika, Pstruh na paprice. – same as Carp with paprika sauce –

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.

  • • 2 bacon slices cut in thin strips
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • 1 medium onion, finely chopped
  • • 4 medium potatoes, parboiled, sliced
  • • juice of 1 lemon
  • • 2 teaspoons paprika
  • • salt
  • • 1 pint sour cream

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Sauté onion in butter.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Meanwhile, sprinkle pike with salt, paprika and lemon juice. Lard with strips of bacon. Lay fish in a lightly greased baking pan. Arrange potato slices on sides of fish and up, towards the edge of the pan. Sprinkle some salt over potatoes.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Pour the butter onion mixture over fish. Top with sour cream. Bake at 350F, 30-40 minutes.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serve with tomato salad, vegetables.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.

children.html: Salmon trout with dill sauce - Pstruh s koprovou omáčkou

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 6 trouts, 4 lbs., cleaned, with heads and tails left on
  • • 1/2 bottle white wine
  • • 1.1/2 quarts water
  • • 1 medium onion, quartered
  • • juice of one lemon
  • • 10 black peppercorns
  • • 2 bay leaves
  • • 6 tablespoons butter
  • • parsley, finely chopped
  • • salt

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: Sauce:

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 3 tablespoons butter and 4 tablespoons flour
  • • 2 tablespoons finely chopped dill
  • • 1 small onion, finely chopped
  • • parsley, finely chopped
  • • 2 cups fish broth
  • • 1 tablespoon vinegar
  • • 1 teaspoon sugar
  • • 1/2 cup heavy cream
  • • salt

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html:
Heat the wine, water, onion, lemon juice, bay leaves and peppercorns. Simmer 10 minutes. Add the trouts and simmer gently for 15 minutes, without boiling.

Drain fish, arrange on a heated serving platter, keep it warm. Strain the broth from the fish, reserve 2 cups for dill sauce. Meanwhile, prepare the sauce. Melt butter in a saucepan, blend in flour, stir and cook until golden. Add onion, parsley, fish broth, vinegar, sugar, salt. Cook, uncovered, until sauce thickens. Strain. Blend in the cream and chopped dill. Heat through, do not boil. Pour hot butter over trouts, garnish with parsley. Hand sauce separately.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 45 minutes

children.html: Ham and noodles casserole - Šunkové nudle

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 12 oz. egg noodles
  • • 8 oz. fully cooked ham slices, cut into short strips
  • • 3 eggs, separated
  • • 4 tablespoons butter
  • • grated rind of 1 lemon
  • • salt
  • • 1 tablespoon butter
  • • 2 tablespoons bread crumbs.
  • • 2/3 cup heavy cream

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Cook noodles in lightly salted water, drain and splash with cold water. In a bowl cream butter, egg yolks, lemon rind. Combine mixture with noodles and ham. Blend thoroughly. Fold in 3 stiffly beaten egg whites. Put into buttered and bread crumbs coated casserole. Pour the cream evenly over top and bake uncovered at 350F 35-40 minutes or until golden brown on top. Serve straight from oven, with green salad or tomato salad.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 1 hour 15 minutes

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: Stuffed peppers - Plněné papriky

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 6 medium size green peppers
  • • 3 tablespoons vegetable oil
  • • 1 small onion, finely chopped
  • • 1 lb. finely ground pork or beef
  • • 1 egg, whole
  • • 1/2 cup firmly cooked rice
  • • 2 tablespoons butter
  • • 2 cups tomato sauce
  • • salt

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Slice stem ends from peppers, remove white fiber and seeds. Drop into boiling salted water, simmer 1 minute. Drain on a sieve or paper towel. Pat dry cavities.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Meanwhile, heat oil in a skillet, add onion and ground meat, sauté 10 minutes, mixing often. Blend in the egg, rice and salt. Spoon mixture into peppers, pressing firmly towards bottom and sides.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Arrange stuffed peppers in a flameproof buttered casserole, pour tomato sauce over all. Simmer, covered, 30-35 minutes. Serve with noodles or gnocchi.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 1 hour 15 minutes

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: Stuffed cabbage rolls - Plněná kapusta

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 savoy cabbage head
  • • 1/2 lb. ground veal
  • • 1/2 lb. ground pork
  • • 1 cup chicken stock
  • • 1 hard baked roll
  • • 1/2 cup milk
  • • 2 small onions, chopped
  • • 2 cloves garlic, pressed or chopped
  • • 1 egg, whole
  • • 4 tablespoons butter
  • • minced parsely
  • • marjoram
  • • salt and pepper

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Pull off 12 large leaves from the cabbage head. Parboil them in salted water, place each on a napkin and flatten it with rolling pin or hand. Soak roll in milk, squeeze off excess and shred it. In a mixing bowl combine ground meat, shredded roll, 1 chopped onion, minced parsely, marjoram, garlic, salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly and spread evenly on the cabbage leaves. Roll them tightly, fasten each with a string or wooden pick. In a large skillet sauté onion in butter, add the stuffed cabbage rolls, simmer 30-40 minutes, adding occasionally some of the chicken stock. Lift rolls onto a serving dish, sprinkle with juices from the pan, serve with rice or potatoes.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 1 hour 15 minutes

children.block_description: The header of a section of text or other blocks.
children.html: Green cabbage - Hlávkové zelí

children.block_description: A group of list items that should be rendered together.
children.html:
• • 1 head of cabbage, about 2 lbs.
  • • 1 medium onion, finely chopped
  • • 4 tablespoons vegetable oil
  • • 3 tablespoons flour
  • • caraway seeds
  • • 1/3 cup vinegar
  • • 2 tablespoons sugar
  • • salt

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Discard outside leaves from the fresh head of cabbage. Quarter, core, rinse and cut in strips. Scald with boiling water. Drain. Sauté onion in oil until translucent. Add cabbage, salt and caraway seeds. Simmer, turning occasionally, until cabbage is tender but crisp, about 15-20 minutes. Blend in flour, simmer 2-3 minutes. Add vinegar and sugar, simmer 1-2 minutes until thoroughly heated through. Serve with pork roast, meatloaf, smoked pork.

children.block_description: A paragraph or line of text.
children.html: Serves 6 – Preparation time: 45 minutes
